body:
Found out that you are able to donate money directly to Developers and some other areas. Would it be possible if you could add Administrators to the list as well, so the community can crowdfund compensation for admins if they so wish? As in, if admins wish to participate in the program, people can donate and for instance, admins receive a cut.

(This question may be better directed for an admin or #global member to answer)
